description: A dense grid of sets with the piece count and the rolls of each.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Sushi sets as a dense grid of tiles: a square picture with the piece count over it, the name, the rolls of the
  set as a list, the price and an add button. Axes: cols (3, 4), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type SushiSetsProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    cols?: "3" | "4";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import AddIcon from "../components/add-icon.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    cols = "4",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: SushiSetsProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="package" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Grid cols={(((cols as string) === "3") ? "1-3" : "1-4")} class="gap-4" data-slot="items">
      {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
        <Stack gap="4" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-slot="item">
          <Box class="relative">
            <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio="1/1" />
            <Badge variant="default" size="default" class="absolute left-2 top-2">
              {d.weight}
            </Badge>
          </Box>
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
            {d.name}
          </Text>
          <List
            tag="ul"
            class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground"
            aria-label={tpl(labels.pieces, d.name)}
          >
            {#each d.items as r (r)}
              <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="items-row">
                <LucideIcon name="check" size={16} />
                <Inline>
                  {r}
                </Inline>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
          <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between" class="mt-auto">
            <Inline class="text-lg font-bold">
              {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
            </Inline>
            <AddIcon label={tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)} variant="default" />
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
